scope.window_enforcement: The project coverage window starts 2024-07-01. Spending on or after that date is inside the window. The registry records that start. October 1 school year 2025-2026 is a separate comparison: it pairs only with spending dated 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30.

transformations.step: Download the official URL and require the SHA-256 in pipeline/documents.py. A different hash is stored under its own name and is not indexed as this document.

Text-native Scottsdale AP PDFs use susd_ap_report_pdf. Diligent voucher account summaries use diligent_voucher_account_summary. Paper-capture scans use the OCR layout parser. A cover-page fund total is not a vendor line. A P-card merchant and its clearing-account payee stay on one line.

A document enters the public index only when parsed detail lines match the printed total on that same document. Paradise Valley stays out until a printed total can be reconciled. An unindexed file is not zero spending.

Check date, voucher batch date, and the native fiscal-year label are separate columns. A voucher batch date is not copied into check_date. School year 2025 in the registry means a transaction on or after 2024-07-01; the ingest does not drop lines solely for an earlier date. OCR batch dates are flagged ocr_batch_date_unreviewed and voucher_batch_date is null until reviewed. The raw OCR string may remain in voucher_batch_date_raw and is not a transaction date.
Amounts are integer cents from the printed dollars. Floats are not used for money.

Every public line is tagged reported_ap_or_vouchered_not_settlement. That is a reported AP or vouchered amount, not proof a payment settled. po_raw may sit on an AP line. The public sum uses amount_cents of that line, not a separate purchase-order commitment total. Govly purchase-order awards are excluded_secondary_PO and are not public lines.

A row is public only when the payee is classed safe_business_vendor and the vendor plus description have no email, phone, street address, long digit identifier, reimbursement or student context, authorized-user text, IEP or ESY, or medicaid, diagnosis, or prescription language. Personal and unknown payees are quarantined in the private silver table. The public table omits the row. Hiding a column is not the control. This is an AP and voucher extract, not a payroll register. Public lines generally do not include salaries. Withheld personal lines are not a payroll substitute.
Indexed public lines start with in_default_aggregate = 1. A line whose check date sits on an unresolved shared-date overlap is set to 0 and left out of the default total, charts, and CSV.

Categories use phoenix-k12-neutral-2026.11.11. Account titles are stronger than item text. Unclassified is the default. Metered natural gas, water, sewer, and electricity are utilities. Amazon is a vendor, not a category. Categories are not USFR codes. Item groups are reviewed description phrases with a label, evidence span, method, and confidence. A not-to-exceed figure in the text is not the line amount.

Load the ADE October 1 extracts into the public database. An asterisk or a blank Total stays null. 2010-2011 residence pairs are not summed. School year YYYY-(YYYY+1) pairs with spending dated July 1, YYYY through June 30, YYYY+1. Screened spending amounts are not changed.

Merge screened historic public lines beside the existing index. A document whose id or SHA-256 is already stored is skipped. An indexed document is kept only when public cents plus withheld cents plus non-spending cents equal the printed total. Unreconciled documents are listed with no public lines and are not zero spending. Native fiscal-year and period labels stay as printed. Amounts stay integer cents and are reported or vouchered, not settlement proof.

enrollment.note: Official ADE October 1 enrollment workbooks for school years 2010-2011 through 2025-2026 are loaded from the published extracts. Counts are the printed Total column. An asterisk or a blank Total is null and is not filled. This is a headcount of students enrolled on October 1, not ADM. A per-student figure is a reported amount in this index per enrolled student. It is not cost per pupil and not total district spending. School year 2025-2026 pairs with spending dated 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30. District totals for 2010-2011 through 2016-2017 are not on the same basis as 2017-2018 onward and are not shown as one continuous series.
